data.one_liner: HTTP/2 adapter for Dio with connection reuse and header compression
data.what_it_does: Provides an HTTP/2 client adapter for the Dio HTTP client. It manages connection pooling, header compression, and supports fallbacks to HTTP/1.1 when necessary. It also offers configuration for timeouts, proxies, and bad certificate handling.
use_when: You need HTTP/2 support in a Dio-based app
You want connection reuse and header compression for performance
You need to customize TLS or proxy settings for Dio
avoid_when: You are not using Dio as your HTTP client
You only need basic HTTP/1.1 functionality
You prefer a pure Dart HTTP client like http
strengths: Built on top of Dio, so integrates seamlessly with existing Dio code
Supports connection reuse and header compression for efficient traffic
Provides fallback to HTTP/1.1 and configurable protocols
Offers detailed configuration for timeouts, proxies, and bad certificates
weaknesses: Only works with Dio, not a standalone HTTP client
Limited to HTTP/2 and HTTP/1.1, no other protocols
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec dependencies and set `dio.httpClientAdapter = Http2Adapter(...)` in code

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Dio itself supports HTTP/1.1 and can be used without the adapter if HTTP/2 is not required
